build: A pixel-staircase wipe turns light to dark. 'In two weeks,' builds word by word while the elevator counter scrambles up from 3,100,000.
hold: The counter locks on 3,300,000 (11.9 s) and the caption dims to grey for a beat.
hit_what: A giant green '3.3' slams in over the dimmed caption (12.19). It is replaced by a giant 'million' (12.60), then both shrink inline into '🚀 3.3 million' (12.94).
after: 'views.' lands (13.43) and an eye icon appears in the elevator car; held about 0.2 s before the next line.
sound: The voice stresses 'three point three million'. The bed carries on; no break.
techniques: hero-word slam then shrink into the line
caption dims while the hero word holds
pixel-staircase wipe into a dark scene
why_it_works: A concrete, outsized number arrives twice, as the counter and as a giant word, so the proof feels physical.

build: Pixel wipe to dark. A silver coin carrying the product's icon floats on a pedestal. 'Your job is the' builds, then a giant green 'product.' slams (62.39).
hold: 'Its job' builds over a quick coin flip (63.06, motion-blurred).
hit_what: The coin lands brand-side and audience avatars burst out to orbit it as a giant green 'audience.' slams in (63.55).
after: The avatars keep orbiting while the hero word shrinks into the line (63.97). Then the whole scene breaks into pixels and the launch/CTA scene assembles (64.05).
sound: The two lines in mirrored rhythm ('Your job is the product. Its job is the audience.'). The bed continues.
techniques: coin flip as the turn (your side, then its side)
burst of orbiting avatars on the hit
why_it_works: The flip turns the slogan into an object: the viewer sees their job hand over to the tool at the exact word.
